Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Finalize Q2 invoice sender & VAT evidence path

Hi Sophie —

Quick follow on our onboarding call: we need to lock who creates/sends the Q2 invoice and how you want VAT evidence attached so your AP ledger can match it without friction. Two options we typically use for customers in your region:

1) Portal-first: Redwood pushes the finalized PDF/UBL to your billing portal (preferred for automatic reconciliation). We include VAT metadata and a link to the signed VAT certificate.
2) Email-first (manual): We email a signed PDF to finance@greenline.eu and optionally push to the portal as a secondary copy.

Can you confirm your preference? If you pick portal-first, please confirm the portal receiver ID (or vendor ID) and whether your AP needs the PDF copy to finance@greenline.eu as well. If email-first please confirm the PO number we should reference and attach your VAT certificate for our records.

Also flagging two internal asks for my team:
- Kimberly: if portal-first, please plan to push via API (we need the target vendor ID + SFTP/portal webhook details).
- Marissa: please prepare a draft PDF (invoice_Q2-2027-draft.pdf) that includes the VAT line and our standard tax note.

Sophie — aiming to send the final invoice by EOD Friday so your AP sees it this billing cycle.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: invoice_Q2-2027-draft.pdf (draft, pdf)

Hi Ben —

Thanks for laying this out. Greenline prefers option 1 (portal-first) for production invoices — our AP system will auto-ingest portal pushes and match to POs. That said, our AP requires a same-day PDF copy to finance@greenline.eu for manual checks during the first two billing cycles. So we'll need both: portal push as canonical + email copy to finance@greenline.eu.

Details:
- Vendor ID: GL-4521
- PO: PO-88921 (please reference on the invoice)
- VAT number: GB123456789 (attached)
- AP contact: finance@greenline.eu (please cc)

I've attached our VAT registration certificate and a short note from AP confirming the vendor ID mapping.

Thanks — let me know if you need a signed W-9 equivalent (we're EU-based so VAT cert suffices).

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Turner
Head of Finance Operations, Greenline Ltd.
